tagline.en_US: Single-server website CMS and visual editor with SQLite-backed content, media uploads, forms, and publishing.

description.en_US: Instatic is a self-hosted website content management system and visual canvas editor. It integrates a visual page builder, structured content engine, media manager, form handling, and publishing tools into a single server. Published pages are compiled directly to semantic HTML and compact CSS without frontend framework runtimes. It allows users to visually design, structure, and publish standalone websites.
